title: Advanced Partial Differential Equations

syllabus.details: Distribution Theory : Test functions and Distributions, Convolutions of Distributions,Fundamental solutions.
Sobolev Spaces : Definition and elementary properties of Sobolev spaces, Density results,Extensions, Traces, Sobolev inequalities, Compactness Theorems.

Weak solutions of second order elliptic boundary value problems: Variational formulation ofsome boundary value problems, Lax-Milgram Theorem, Dirichlet and Neumann problems for second orderelliptic operators, Regularity of weak solutions, Maximum principles, Eigenvalue problems.

textbooks: S. Kesavan, Topics in functional analysis and applications, New age international publishers,ISBN-13 : 978 -8122437973.
L. C. Evans, Partial Differential Equations, American Mathematical Society, ISBN-13 : 978-0821849743.
references: H. Brezis, Functional Analysis, Sobolev Spaces and Partial Differential Equations, Springer,ISBN-13 : 978-0387709130.
R. A. Adams, J. F. Fournier, Sobolev Spaces , Academic press, Elsevier, ISBN-13 : 978-0120441433.
